story: Explore the fascinating world of the Barn Owl (Tyto alba). Classified under the Tytonidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits Open habitats: grasslands; deserts; marshes; agricultural fields; and farmlands. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Barn Owl is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the Barn Owl, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
